key_insight: β-OPSD generalizes vanilla OPSD by treating the KL anchor as a tunable β parameter, turning self-distillation into a principled policy-optimization family with a closed-form teacher-reference interpolation.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more stable and controllable recipe for training reasoning models, preserving OPSD’s efficiency while reducing brittle hyperparameter and engineering dependence.
method: Recasts OPSD as policy optimization with a β-weighted KL penalty to a reference policy.
Derives an optimal policy as geometric interpolation between the reference policy and privileged teacher.
Uses the closed-form optimum as a distillation target via token-level logit mixing, with return-to-go for sequence-level credit assignment.
evidence_signal: Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks in the abstract report consistent gains over vanilla OPSD in both optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance.
watch_item: Directly implementing the RL objective is high-variance and costly, so the distillation approximation must still be carefully aligned with the intended β setting and sequence-level credit assignment.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
